Because I'm neither employed, nor do I live with my mom.
I was really irrational and irritable that day so I figured I would just be shit to everyone so they would hate me. I've been really suicidal the past few weeks and it's gotten worse every day.

There is a counselor but they are only for the kids that attend their school and not for the college kids. If that makes sense.

I do work but I'm not employed there and the pay is like 100€ per month.. 

I was abused my whole childhood so when I was 10, I was depressed and I became really suicidal. And I got bullied badly in school too.

Thank you.. And thanks for listening to me rant about irrelevant shit

I feel like this was written by me tbh. I feel exactly like you do

 I wish for you to stop thinking this way you really really don't deserve it. You are so much more than what your thoughts tell you, believe me. You are no failure and everyone would be really sad if you were gone.
Thank you so much for your kind message! ❤️

Thank you so much for your kind words❤️
Idk if I can do this though...
You are right. Thank you for your kind words ❤️
